_comment: The villain's scenes (Expansion 6 E.2, docs/ADVENTURES.md §5.4, §5.18): its visit to your room at the inn (story._stage_at_inn; the beat it brings is the scene's `then`), and the example it made of one who helped you, seen when you next walk into their town (villain.seen_in_town: the crowd at the gibbet, or at the ashes of their house). Words given: {villain}, {villain_short}, {hero}, {home} (the visit); {helper}, {helper_first}, {villain} (the example).

villain_visit_inn.about: In the black hour the lamp gutters, and there is someone in the room who did not come in by the door: the villain, come to talk. It speaks, and the beat opens; then it is gone.

first: Do not get up. I have only come to look at you.
Sit. We are both too tired for anything else tonight.
Quietly, now. The house is asleep, and so should you be.
Keep your hands where they are. I have not come to harm you.
I thought it time we spoke, you and I, without an audience.
The door was locked. I know. Do not trouble to look at it.
last: Remember that I came, and that I went.
You will find the door still locked. Good night.
Think on what I said. I shall ask again.
No need to see me out.

reprisal_gibbet.about: A gibbet stands in the square where none stood before, and on it what is left of one who helped you; a crowd round it, murmuring, and then it breaks up.

murmur: They left a paper on the body. With a name on it.
Who will cut them down? Nobody dares.
It was for helping the stranger, they say.
Don't look. Don't let the children look.
Three days it will hang, by order.
mourner: That was {helper_first}. They only helped you. That was all they did.
Look at it. Look what {villain} does to those who help you.
Cut them down, someone. Please. Somebody.
{helper_first} gave you a bed. This is what the bed cost.
Go on, look. Take a good look, and then take it away from us.
They had no quarrel with anyone. Until you came.

reprisal_ashes.about: The burned shell of the house of one who helped you, still smoking; the neighbours stand about it, and one of them turns on you.

murmur: Nobody came to help. Nobody dared.
It is still warm, the ash.
Said it was a lesson. For all of us.
The roof-beams fell in about dawn.
Not even a dog left alive in it.
mourner: {helper_first} is under that. Are you pleased?
You brought this on us. You and {villain} between you.
We heard them in there. All night we will hear them.
Whatever you wanted from {helper_first}, you have had it now.
Stand there if you like. The ash will not mind.
We shared a wall with them. Now we share this.
